title: Make codex-usage test deterministic under host load
body:
Outcome: test/hosts/codex-usage.test.ts is deterministic under host load. Observed 2026-11-01: failed inside npm run gate:local (krn deliver PR #152, load ~13-19, exit 75) while CI on the same head passed and `node scripts/test-suite.mjs test/hosts/codex-usage.test.ts` passed 5/5 in isolation. Gate log only says "file summary failed"; capture the failing assertion.
Proof: the file passes repeatedly under synthetic CPU load (stress loop) and the gate log names the failing subtest when it fails.
